svg.title: mwm2
svg.desc: Two displays. Holding Left Option, a terminal is dragged by its contents and snaps to an editor, a notes window is dropped on the right display's outer edge and tiles to its right half, the terminal is maximized and restored with double-clicks, resized toward the other display while its outline stops at its own screen, and a drag of the notes window is cancelled with Escape.

g.text: Hold left ⌥ and drag from anywhere. Edges snap.
Drop on an outer edge to tile.
Double-click to maximize, again to restore.
Right-drag to resize. It stays on its screen.
